```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Paste your "Publish to web" CSV link for the Teaching tab here
teaching_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTQwbP30e1rj9eR6NlSgrRrSbZybMghHNGoXHa2GylcFEaJjL3SP5j4-EdyG3Qj4MizkSyLRW9QH0dT/pub?gid=1469525006&single=true&output=csv"

teaching <- read_csv(teaching_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

render_bullet <- function(title, subtitle, description) {
  header <- if (!is.na(subtitle) && nzchar(trimws(subtitle))) {
    sprintf("-   **%s** \\| *%s*\n\n", title, subtitle)
  } else {
    sprintf("-   **%s**\n\n", title)
  }
  cat(header)
  if (!is.na(description) && nzchar(trimws(description))) {
    cat(sprintf("    -   %s\n\n", description))
  }
}
```

## Teaching Assistantships

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

ta <- teaching |> filter(Type == "Teaching Assistantship")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ta))) {
  semesters <- ta$Semesters[i]
  full_title <- if (!is.na(semesters) && nzchar(trimws(semesters))) {
    sprintf("%s (%s)", ta$Course[i], semesters)
  } else {
    ta$Title[i]
  }
  render_bullet(full_title, ta$Organization[i], ta$Description[i])
}
```

## Guest Lectures

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

guest <- teaching |> filter(Type == "Guest Lecture")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(guest))) {
  cat(sprintf("1.  \"%s\"; %s. %s.\n", guest$Title[i], guest$Course[i], guest$Dates[i]))
}
```

## Professional Development

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

prof_dev <- teaching |> filter(Type == "Professional Development")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(prof_dev))) {
  render_bullet(prof_dev$Title[i], prof_dev$Organization[i], prof_dev$Description[i])
}
```
